title: Exploration and Experimentation with a Misspecified Simulator
abstract: arXiv:2605.21458v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Randomized experiments are the standard for measuring causal effects that guide decisions, but are costly. Simulators calibrated to historical data offer a cheaper alternative, but their policies can become suboptimal under drift, a change in dynamics after calibration. We study if, when, and how to collect data for recalibrating the simulator. We consider a system with multiple units running in parallel and managed by a single operator. The real-world system is a partially observed process with a latent variable, while the simulator models it as a fully observed Markovian process, and thus is misspecified. Two data collection strategies exploit the current policy: (i) never recalibrating and (ii) recalibrating from on-policy data (passive adaptation). Two others collect off-policy data by trying actions outside the current policy: (iii) continuous exploration across all units and (iv) randomized experimentation on a sample of units

translated_title: 使用错误设定模拟器的探索与实验
translated_abstract: 随机化实验是衡量因果效应以指导决策的标准方法，但成本高昂。根据历史数据校准的模拟器提供了一种更廉价的替代方案，但在发生漂移（即校准后系统动态发生变化）时，其策略可能变得次优。我们研究是否、何时以及如何收集数据以重新校准模拟器。我们考虑一个由多个单元并行运行并由单一操作者管理的系统。现实世界的系统是一个带有潜变量的部分可观测过程，而模拟器将其建模为完全可观测的马尔可夫过程，因此存在错误设定。两种数据收集策略利用当前策略：（i）从不重新校准，（ii）从在策略数据进行重新校准（被动适应）。另外两种策略通过尝试当前策略之外的动作来收集离策略数据：（iii）在所有单元上进行持续探索，以及（iv）在部分单元样本上进行随机化实验。
tldr: 该论文研究了在模拟器存在错误设定且真实系统动态发生漂移的情况下，是否、何时以及如何通过被动适应、持续探索或随机化实验等数据收集策略来重新校准模拟器。
en_tdlr: This paper studies whether, when, and how to collect data—via passive adaptation, continuous exploration, or randomized experimentation—to recalibrate a misspecified simulator when the real-world system's dynamics have drifted.
